name: Savanna
description: Open grassland with scattered trees; favors plains-adapted stamina and pack coordination.

name: Forest
description: Dense cover rewards camouflage, ambush tactics, and climbing ability.

name: Desert
description: Extreme heat and open sand favor heat-tolerant, water-efficient animals.

name: Arctic
description: Sub-zero cold and snow/ice footing favor cold-resistant, insulated animals.

name: Ocean
description: Fully aquatic environment; land animals are severely disadvantaged.

name: Mountain
description: Steep, rocky, thin-air terrain favors sure-footed, agile climbers.

name: Open Plains
description: Flat, exposed terrain with nowhere to hide; favors speed and pursuit endurance.
